description: Recent AI citation checks: which tracked queries were checked on which AI model and whether the brand was cited. ChatGPT and Grok checks also list the searches the engine ran for the answer, each with targetedBy when one of your articles targets that search. `branded` marks a check of a question that names your brand, which doesn't count toward your score. A check whose answer contradicts one of your facts carries contradiction: your fact and the answer's claim.

before.description: Only checks older than this (ISO date or milliseconds). A full page returns nextBefore: pass it here for the next older page.

engines.description: Only these engines' answers: their ids, comma-separated (chatgpt, perplexity, claude, gemini, grok, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview). Leave it out for all seven.

limit.description: Most recent checks to return (default 100, max 200)

model.description: Filter by AI model, e.g. chatgpt, perplexity

topic.description: One topic's questions only: its id or name from get_topics, or none for questions with no topic. Leave it out for the whole workspace.

name: list_citations
